functie: Senior Lecturer (Academic Development - Digital Learning and Pedagogy)
citaat: Consistency and standardization in feedback between multiple markers is a significant issue. Variation in marking and feedback quality between different tutors marking the same cohort affects student experience negatively.
samenvatting: Verschil tussen markers binnen een cohort is hun grootste klacht.

functie: Senior Lecturer (Academic Development - Digital Learning and Pedagogy)
citaat: High staff workload due to marking volume creates delays in assessment turnaround and feedback provision.
samenvatting: Nakijkvolume vertraagt de doorlooptijd van feedback.

functie: Senior Lecturer (Academic Development - Digital Learning and Pedagogy)
citaat: The university has four student intake periods per year, with some programs receiving 300-400 student entries.
samenvatting: Vier instroommomenten met 300-400 studenten per programma.

functie: Senior Lecturer (Academic Development - Digital Learning and Pedagogy)
citaat: The institution serves over 90% international students, with English not being their first language for the majority.
samenvatting: 90% internationale studenten, taalfeedback moet daarop passen.

functie: Senior Lecturer (Academic Development - Digital Learning and Pedagogy)
citaat: While some modules have rubrics, they are not universally applied across all programs at the university.
samenvatting: Rubrics bestaan wel maar niet overal, dat raakt de inrichting.

functie: Senior Lecturer (Academic Development - Digital Learning and Pedagogy)
citaat: An AI policy is currently in development, allowing AI tools for assessment support such as structuring, layout, and grammar checking. Program-specific AI policies are being created.
samenvatting: AI-beleid is nog in ontwikkeling, per programma ingevuld.

functie: Senior Lecturer (Academic Development - Digital Learning and Pedagogy)
citaat: The university prefers AI as an assistant to generate feedback suggestions rather than as a comparison tool to save time. Lecturers would be able to adjust AI-generated feedback and add personal comments.
samenvatting: AI als assistent met docent aan het stuur, niet als vergelijker.

functie: Senior Lecturer (Academic Development - Digital Learning and Pedagogy)
citaat: University of Sunderland is currently evaluating multiple assessment tools, including FeedbackFruits, which is identified as a key competitor.
samenvatting: Ze vergelijken ons rechtstreeks met FeedbackFruits.

functie: Senior Lecturer (Academic Development - Digital Learning and Pedagogy)
citaat: budget-wise, it could be a fit, but it would be something for the next academic year (2027-2028), not the upcoming academic year, since those budgets are already finalized
samenvatting: Budget is al vastgezet, pas volgend studiejaar ruimte.

functie: Senior Lecturer (Academic Development - Digital Learning and Pedagogy)
citaat: The university's current AI policy states that lecturers cannot use AI for feedback and grading.
samenvatting: Universiteitsbeleid verbiedt docenten AI bij feedback en cijfers.

functie: Senior Lecturer (Academic Development - Digital Learning and Pedagogy)
citaat: if we are able to make a compelling business case, showing that lecturers are currently in a negative situation, there would be possibilities to set up a pilot. Case studies should be included in that document.
samenvatting: Een business case met case studies opent de deur ondanks het beleid.
